company.name: SlideScope: Professional Microscopy Image Viewer
identity_limitations: Do not merge with slidescope.net / Jonas Teuwen or slidescope.app; these are different identities.
Legal entity and named founder have not been established.

track.rationale: Research microscopy viewing and quantification; sources explicitly limit clinical use.

plain_language_product_or_program: SlideScope offers a desktop application that lets research laboratories view, measure and quantify microscopy images from different instrument formats in one workspace.
user_or_patient_population: Microscopy researchers, laboratory/core-facility staff and educators; not a clinically validated diagnostic population.

independence_limitations: Multiple pages are one interested source family, not independent corroboration.

sources.title: SlideScope microscopy viewer
sources.date_basis: Page displays a dated release label; exact latest version differs between observed indexed renders and needs direct release-note verification.
sources.paraphrase: Company offers a downloadable Windows/macOS viewer for mixed microscopy formats, measurement and local quantification. It lists samples and demonstrations. Research use is explicit; software was not installed or tested.
limitations: Product page and demo links inspected as text only; no executable test, customer adoption or performance verification.
Testimonials on the company's own site are not independent validation.

sources.title: About SlideScope — Independent Microscopy Software
sources.paraphrase: The company describes an independent desktop viewer addressing fragmented vendor formats. It distinguishes its review workflow from scriptable analysis pipelines and clinical diagnosis. No named founder or individual authorship is provided on the inspected page.
limitations: Company identity and product purpose are source-reported; no named person's contribution, founder status, tenure or rights established.

sources.title: Cell and Nuclei Quantification on Your Own Computer
sources.paraphrase: Documentation describes local segmentation using InstanSeg or thresholding, saved analysis recipes, overlays for manual correction and CSV/GeoJSON/mask exports. Results require visual quality control and are not validated for diagnostic decisions.
limitations: Methods described by vendor, not reproduced here.
Using an external segmentation model does not establish proprietary model ownership or superior performance.

sources.title: SlideScope Release Notes
sources.date_basis: Company-declared release date for stable1.13.0; no binary executed.
sources.paraphrase: Dated release notes describe viewer updates, free sample workflows and image-format handling; stable1.13.0 is labeled23October2026. Earlier notes describe quality checks and slide alignment.
limitations: Self-published release history is not independently reproduced functionality, adoption or personal contribution.
